title: 第900章 女魔头一剑破万法第899章 天道囚笼红裙倩影
slug: 魔门送葬开局被女帝逆推
lines: 看到这一幕，洛苍脸色骤变，连忙是冲着洛裳舞暴喝一声，脸色无比难看：“再说了……若要挡在宁小子身前，那也是老夫来！”
“洛丫头快速速退下，不可乱来！”
“我知道你担心宁小子，但那家伙…不是寻常对手！”
洛擎天和洛长明两人也是脸色无比凝重，连忙是劝说道。
洛青霄目光看去，神情无比凝重。
“神王境五星的气息…如此年纪，便已达到神王五星……也是天赋怪。”
当极寒神王，天寒神尊以及太古神王等人目光看去之时，脸色也满是深深的凝重和担忧之色。
“神王五星？天赋不错，但不够看，桀桀放心，吾先将你镇杀，再送那小子和你团聚！让你夫妻二人，做个亡命鸳鸯！”
寂灭神王目光看去，眼中神色越发淡漠，仿佛在看着一只蝼蚁。
洛裳舞抬眸，那绝美俏脸布满淡漠冰寒之色，她抬起生烬，极致的剑意在此刻凝聚，淡淡的看着寂灭神王。
洛苍看到这一幕，更是无比焦急。
天道囚笼之中，宁尘目光始终落在自家娘子身上，接着他嘴角掀起一抹笑容来，轻笑着说道：“娘子，交给你，没问题吧？”
洛裳舞手持生烬，螓首轻点。
听到这话，洛苍等人更是有些云里雾里，不知道宁尘和洛裳舞两人究竟想要做什么。
而此话一出，寂灭神王脸色骤变，没有丝毫犹豫，直接是一掌抬起，灭世之威尽数朝着洛裳舞落去！
“区区一个神王五星的小女娃，死吧！”
看到这一幕，地魂界众人脸色大变，眼中满是深深担忧。
content_en:
"Luo Yatou?!"
"Luo Yatou, what are you doing?"
"Don't mess around!"
"..."
Seeing this scene, Luo Cang's expression changed suddenly, and he shouted at Luo Shangwu, his expression extremely ugly: "Besides... If you want to stand in front of Mr. Ning, it's me who will do it!"
"Luo Yatou, retreat quickly and don't act recklessly!"
“我知道你担心宁小子，但那家伙…不是寻常对手！”
"Yeah..."
"Don't mess around!"
“速速退下！”
Luo Qingtian and Luo Changming also had extremely solemn expressions on their faces and hurriedly tried to persuade them.
"Shangwu girl..."
Luo Qingxiao looked at it with an extremely solemn expression.
"Is that Fellow Daoist Ning's wife?"
"The aura of the five-star God King Realm... At such an age, he has already reached the five-star level of the God King... and he is also a genius."
"But..."
"That opponent is the God King of Annihilation..."
"..."
When the Extreme Cold God King, Tianhan God Lord, and the Ancient God King looked at him, their faces were filled with deep solemnity and worry.
"Are you that boy's wife?"
"Five-star God King? His talent is good, but not good enough. Don't worry, Jiejie. I will kill you first, and then send that kid to reunite with you! Let you and your wife be desperate mandarin ducks!"
The God King of Annihilation looked around, his eyes becoming more and more indifferent, as if he was looking at an ant.
"You...want to kill your husband?"
Luo Shangwu raised her eyes, her beautiful face was filled with indifference and coldness. She raised the burning embers, her ultimate sword intent was condensed at this moment, and she looked at the God King of Annihilation lightly.
"Boy Ning, hurry...quickly persuade Luo Yatou to come down!"
Luo Cang was even more anxious when he saw this scene.
"Grandpa."
"Isn't it good to trust my wife?"
In the Heavenly Prison, Ning Chen's eyes were always on his wife, and then a smile appeared on the corner of his mouth, and he said with a chuckle: "My wife, I leave it to you, is it okay?"
"Yeah."
"Husband, just do what you want to do."
Luo Shangwu held a burning ember in her hand and nodded lightly.
Hearing this, Luo Cang and others were a little confused, not knowing what Ning Chen and Luo Shangwu wanted to do.
"Arrogant!"
As soon as these words came out, the face of the God King of Annihilation suddenly changed. Without any hesitation, he directly raised his palm and directed the world-destroying power towards Luo Shangwu!
"Just a little girl with five stars from the God King, let's die!"
Boom!
Boom boom!
The terrifying coercion exploded!
“洛丫头！！！”
Seeing this scene, the expressions of everyone in the Earth Soul World changed drastically, and their eyes were full of deep worry.
title_en: Chapter 900: The female devil breaks all laws with one sword Chapter 899: The beautiful figure in the red dress in the cage of heaven
